entities.summary: Colby Shane Cohen is an American former professional ice hockey defenseman. He played 3 games in the National Hockey League with the Colorado Avalanche and in the AHL with the Providence Bruins, the minor league affiliate of the Boston Bruins. Currently, Colby serves as an NCAA college ice hockey and NHL color analyst for Westwood One and ESPN.
